options.text: Can I have another Varrock platebody?

steps.player: Can I have another Varrock platebody?

steps.text: Toby gives you another Varrock platebody.

steps.npc: I'm Toby, the taskmaster for the Varrock Achievement Diary.

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In Varrock and the surrounding area it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will
reward you.

steps.text: The player's Achievement Diaries tab is opened

steps.npc: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.

options.text: I have a question about my Achievement Diary

steps.player: I have a question about my Achievement diary.

steps.npc: Well, there are four different Varrock armours, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
know more about?

steps.player: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!

steps.npc: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Varrock, you have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to coal and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to steel, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff will
stock 15 Battlestaves per day.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy rewards, you have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to mithril and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to mithril, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff will stock 30
Battlestaves per day

steps.player: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to adamant and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to adamant, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff
will stock 60 Battlestaves per day and you can access the bank at the Cooking guild.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, you have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to runite and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to runite, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff will stock
120 Battlestaves per day and the plate functions as a Prospector top.

options.text: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.player: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.npc: Just complete the tasks in the Varrock area so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
See you later.
See you later.
